name: Gupi-chan
source:
Gupi-chan is Chichi-chan's new robot meido love slave who is trying discretely to fit in with human society. She has dick-shaped ear receptors that pick up AM radio and contain various super-scientific cords that can do lots of super scientific stuff. She is stoic, obedient, and logical. She is a very new model, and since Gupi-chan does not speak Japanese very well she needs Chichi-chan to give her daily lessons. As Chichi-chan teaches Gupi-chan more and more about the feelings of humans, will she find herself falling in love for the first time? Gupi-chan kawaii!!

[From [url=http://animerand.blogspot.com/2009/05/this-is-development-blog-for-visual.html]Official Site[/url]]
